strengths.mechanism: Basic character setup precedes optional descriptive and Definition fields; greetings and tags convey premise.
strengths.benefitInference: May reduce first-creation effort and help readers choose a suitable premise.

strengths.mechanism: One Memory screen combines story context, pins, editable Facts and usage; new chats offer optional Facts carryover.
strengths.benefitInference: May reduce backstory repetition and clarify deliberate continuity choices.

strengths.mechanism: Shared keyword-triggered Lorebooks have an in-chat viewer and owner editing.
strengths.benefitInference: May reduce canon duplication and interruptions while consulting world details.

strengths.mechanism: Distinct rewind and duplicate-from-message operations; swipe, edit and remove for replies.
strengths.benefitInference: May make alternate paths and local recovery easier.

strengths.mechanism: Message-linked image generation and a mobile gallery with Persona filters and downloads.
strengths.benefitInference: May make visual story moments easier to find and reuse.

tradeoffs.note: Lorebook import maps comment, key and content. Other fields are discarded, including secondary conditions, pattern rules, probabilities, timing, ordering and position. Eight keywords per entry; always-on semantics are not retained.
Export requests may take 3-4 weeks and emailed download links last seven days. This does not establish chat-level export, archive format or reimport.
Ongoing Chapter 11 asset-sale process creates a continuity consideration. No shutdown was observed or established.
Platform filters override Definition choices and may not explain a block.
Facts and full memory visualization are subscription-qualified in the May announcement; Lorebooks remain documented as beta with paid access. Current account entitlements were not tested.
Optional Definition visibility and Hint Only lore visibility can conceal author context. They do not expose the complete assembled prompt.
Troubleshooting still describes Lorebook as forthcoming, while the newer Lorebooks guide documents operation. Use newer feature-specific documentation.

unknowns: Character-card import, complete assembled prompts, external model endpoints and sampler controls were not established.
Export payload completeness, round-trip fidelity and actual processing times were not tested.
Exact-story selection quality, current archive/rename rollout and current group availability across platforms were not verified.
Memory recall, compression fidelity, accessibility, touch usability, offline operation and self-hosting were not established.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Group memory inspection and correction near the conversation, retaining access to advanced controls.
Make fact carryover an explicit choice when starting a story.
Name the preservation and deletion consequences of branching and rewind separately.
Offer lore inspection during a scene and disclose hidden content.
Link generated images to source messages and support later retrieval by story or persona.

doNotCopy.note: Do not silently discard import settings; show a compatibility report before accepting changed semantics.
Do not promise reliable memory retention without evidence.
Do not make a delayed account export the only migration mechanism.
Do not replace expert controls with style names alone; use progressive disclosure.

characterOnboarding.note: Guided create flow, premise greetings, tags, visibility and optional Definition. Character-card import unknown.

storyOrganization.note: Historical rename/archive rollout announcement and later recent-chat descriptions. Current exact-story selection and rollout not verified.

editRetryBranch.note: Swipe alternatives, local edit/remove, destructive Rewind to Here, and original-preserving Start New Chat From Here.

memoryLore.note: Authored/pinned memory, Facts and usage display; shared keyword lore. Paid/beta qualifications apply; recall untested.

promptTransparency.note: Partial author-context visibility only: Definition can be hidden; lore can show hints without content. Full assembled-prompt inspection unknown.

modelConnections.note: Internal Chat Styles picker and Legacy menu documented. External provider or local endpoint configuration unknown.

advancedControls.note: Paid Style Control named but dimensions not inspected. Low-level sampling/context controls unknown.

groupRoleplay.note: September 2025 update describes limited testing of improved multi-character interaction. Current broad access and platform parity not established.

imagesVoice.note: Avatar generation/upload and voice library or clip creation documented; Imagine Message and image gallery documented. Quality and current quotas untested.

mobile.note: Mobile creation entry point and mobile image-gallery workflow documented. No device, accessibility or offline tests.

portability.note: Simplified lore imports and delayed account export documented. Character/chat interchange and export fidelity unknown.
